senses.gloss:
विगण् वि-गण्, cl. 10. P. -गणयति, -यितुम्,
to reckon, compute, calculate; to deliberate, con-
sider, reflect; to esteem, regard; to consider as; to
disregard, take no notice of.

वि-गणन, अम्, n. reckoning, computing; con-
sidering, deliberating; reckoning off, discharge of a
debt.

वि-गणय्य, ind. having reckoned; having de-
liberated or weighed; not having considered.

वि-गणित, अस्, आ, अम्, reckoned, calculated; con-
sidered, weighed; reckoned off, discharged (as a
debt).

विगद् वि-गद्, cl. 1. P. -गदति, -गदितुम्,
to talk about, speak about, repeat, spread a report.
वि-गद, Ved. talking or sounding variously.

वि-गदित, अस्, आ, अम्, talked about, spoken about,
spread abroad (as a report).

विगन्धक वि-गन्धक, अस्, m. ‘having a
bad smell,’ the Iṅgudī tree.

वि-गन्धि, इस्, इस्, इ, smelling badly, having an
unpleasant smell, stinking.
विगन्धिका, f. = हपुषा, q. v.

विगम् वि-गम्, cl. 1. P. -गच्छति, -गन्तुम्,
to go away, pass away, depart, disappear, cease, die,
[]
disperse: Caus. -गमयति, -यितुम्, to cause to go
or pass away; to spend.

2. वि-गत, अस्, आ, अम् (for 1. वि-गत see under
2. वि), gone away, departed, disappeared, ceased, gone;
dead; parted, severed, separated; freed or exempt from,
devoid of; lost; destitute of light, obscured, gloomy,
dark.
—विगत-कल्मष, अस्, आ, अम्, free from
stain or soil, unsoiled, free from sin, sinless; pure,
righteous.
—विगत-क्लम, अस्, आ, अम्, one whose
fatigues have ceased, relieved from fatigue.
—वि-
गत-ज्ञान, अस्, आ, अम्, one who has lost his wits.
—विगत-ज्वर, अस्, आ, अम्, cured of fever; freed
from feverishness or morbid feeling, freed from
trouble or distress of mind; exempt from decay.
—विगत-भी, ईस्, ईस्, इ, one whose fears are gone,
free from fear.
—विगत-मन्यु, उस्, उस्, उ, free
from resentment.
—विगत-राग, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid
of passion or affection.
—विगत-लक्षण, अस्, आ,
अम्, devoid of good or lucky marks, unfortunate, un-
lucky.
—विगत-श्रीक, अस्, आ, अम्, destitute of for-
tune, unfortunate, unprosperous.
—विगत-सङ्कल्-
प, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of purpose or design, without
resolution.
—विगत-स्नेह, अस्, आ, अम्, void of affec-
tion.
—विगत-स्नेह-सौहृद, अस्, आ, अम्, one
who has relinquished love and friendship.
—विगत-
स्पृह, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of wish or desire, in-
different.
—विगतार्तवा (˚त-आर्˚), f. a woman in
whom the menstrual excretion has ceased, one past
child-bearing or one past the age of fifty-five.

वि-गम, अस्, m. departure, secession, decease,
death, withdrawing, relinquishment, separation.

वि-गाम, अस्, m., Ved. a step, pace, stride, (in
Ṛg-veda I. 155, 4. applied to the three strides of
Viṣṇu; Sāy. = विविध-गमन.)

वि-गाम; in regard to the Vedic passage correct
thus — वि-गामन्, अ, n.

विगर वि-गर, अस्, m. ‘not swallowing,’ an
abstemious man; a naked ascetic; a mountain.

विगर्ज् वि-गर्ज्, cl. 1. P. -गर्जति, -गर्जितुम्,
to roar out, cry out.

विगर्ह् वि-गर्ह्, cl. 1. A. -गर्हते, -गर्हि-
तुम्, to blame, abuse, reproach, revile; to disdain,
despise, contemn: Caus. -गर्हयति, -यितुम्, to
revile, rail at, vituperate.

वि-गर्हण, अम्, आ, n. f. blaming, blame, abusing,
abuse, censure, reproach.

वि-गर्हणीय, अस्, आ, अम्, reprehensible, blam-
able, bad, wicked.

1. वि-गर्ह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, reprehensible, blamable.
—विगर्ह्य-कथा, f. reprehensible speech, scandal.
2. वि-गर्ह्य, ind. having blamed or reviled.

विगल् वि-गल्, cl. 1. P. -गलति, -गलितुम्,
to flow or ooze or trickle away, drain off, fall in
drops, drip, distil; to melt away, liquefy, pass away,
disappear, fade away, disperse; to fall down or out,
drop down, drop out; to become loose or untied.

वि-गलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, flowing away, trickling,
dropping, oozing; melting away, dissolving, fading,
dispersing.

वि-गलित, अस्, आ, अम्, flowed away, flowing,
trickled, distilled, oozed, fallen, dropped, melted
away, liquefied, dissolved; dissipated, dispersed,
gone, decayed; slackened, untied (as a knot);
loose, disordered (as hair or dress), untied, detached.
—विगलित-केश, अस्, आ, अम्, having dishevelled hair.
—विगलित-नीवि, इस्, इस्, इ, having the knot untied.

विगा वि-गा (see rt. 1. गा), cl. 3. P. -जिगाति,
गातुम्, Ved. to go or pass away, disappear.
विगान वि-गान. See under वि-गै, col. 3.

वि-गान, अम्, n. singing discordantly, defamation,
ill report, detraction, scandal; censure, reproach.

विगाह् वि-गाह्, cl. 1. A. -गाहते, -गाहितुम्,
गाढुम्, to plunge or dive into (with acc. or loc.),
bathe in; to agitate or stir about, disturb; to enter
into or engage upon; to enter, penetrate, advance
into, pervade; to come on, set in (as a season, the
night, &c.): Pass. -गाह्यते, to be plunged into or
penetrated, to be entered into or engaged upon.

वि-गाढ, अस्, आ, अम्, plunged into, (अम्भसि
विगाढ-मात्रे, at the very moment of the water
being plunged into), bathed in, immersed, bathed,
bathing; come on, advanced, set in, taken place;
deep, excessive.

वि-गाढृ, ढा, ढ्री, ढृ, one who plunges
into; one who agitates or disturbs.

वि-गाह, अस्, m. the act of plunging into (literally
or figuratively), bathing.

वि-गाह्य, ind. having plunged into, having bathed,
having entered.

वि-गाह्यमान, अस्, आ, अम्, being plunged into,
being agitated, being entered or penetrated.

विगुण वि-गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, void of qualities;
having no merit, worthless, bad, barren.

विगुप् वि-गुप्, Desid. A. -जुगुप्सते, to
shrink away from, shun.

विगूढ वि-गूढ, अस्, आ, अम् (see rt. 1. गुह्),
concealed, hidden; blamed, reproached, censured.
—विगूढ-चारिन्, ई, इणी, इ, proceeding or acting
secretly.

विगै वि-गै, cl. 1. P. -गायति, -गातुम्, to
sing variously, sing discordantly or badly; to decry,
abuse, reproach, blame.

वि-गीत, अस्, आ, अम्, sung or said variously; badly
sung; decried, abused, reproached; contradicted,
contradictory, inconsistent.

वि-गीति, इस्, f. singing in various ways, singing ill;
reproach, abuse; contradiction; a kind of metre.
विग्न विग्न. See under rt. 1. विज्.

विग्न, अस्, आ, अम्, shaken, trembling, agitated,
disturbed, alarmed; [cf. उद्-विग्न.]

विग्र विग्र, अस्, आ, अम् (perhaps for वि-अग्र),
noseless [cf. विख, &c.]; wise, (according to Naigh.
III. 15 = मेधा-विन्.)

विग्रथ् वि-ग्रथ् or वि-ग्रन्थ् (see rt. 1. ग्रथ्),
cl. 9. P. -ग्रथ्नाति, -ग्रन्थितुम्, to connect, tie
or bind together, wind round.

वि-ग्रथित, अस्, आ, अम्, connected; containing
knots; having tubercles; clotted; bound up, hin-
dered, obstructed, impeded.

विग्रह् वि-ग्रह् (see rt. ग्रह्), cl. 9. P. A.
-गृह्णाति, -गृह्णीते (Ved. -गृभ्णाति, -गृभ्णीते),
-ग्रहीतुम्, to stretch out or apart, spread out; to hold
apart, keep separate, distribute into parts, divide, dis-
solve, resolve, separate (anything into its constituent
elements), isolate; to quarrel, fight, war, wage war,
wage war against (with acc.); to assault, seize, lay
hold of, take up; to receive in a friendly manner,
welcome; to perceive, observe: Caus. -ग्राहयति,
-यितुम्, to cause to fight, cause to wage war against:
Desid. -जिघृक्षति, to wish to fight against.

वि-गृह्य, ind. having stretched out or apart,
having warred against or contended with.

वि-गृह्यमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being warred upon
or contended with.

वि-ग्रह, अस्, m. stretching out or apart, extension,
expansion; shape, form, figure; the body; (in gram-
mar) separation, resolution, analysis, resolution of a
compound word into its constituent parts, the separa-
tion or analysis of any word capable of separation,
(such words are Kṛdantas, Taddhitas, all Samāsas
or compound words, Ekaśeṣas, and all derivative
verbs like desideratives &c.; the only words incapable
of resolution being the simple verb, the singular of the
noun, and a few indeclinables not derived from roots;
all compounds being called नित्य or ‘fixed,’ when
their meaning cannot be ascertained through an
analysis of their component parts; cf. जमद्-अग्नि);
[]
a division, part, portion; (अस्, अम्), m. n. opposi-
tion, encounter, quarrel, combat, strife, war, battle;
conflict (of the planets); disfavour.
—विग्रह-पर,
अस्, आ, अम्, intent on war, engaged in fighting.
—वि-
ग्रह-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, having form or figure, em-
bodied, incarnate; having a handsome form or shape,
fine, beautiful.
—विग्रहावर (˚ह-अव्˚), अम्, n.
‘the posterior of the body,’ the back.
2. वि-ग्रह, अस्, आ, अम्, free from eclipse.

1. वि-ग्राह्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be warred upon or
contended with.

2. वि-ग्राह्य, ind. having caused to wage war or
fight with.

विग्रीव वि-ग्रीव, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. having the
neck or head cut off, decapitated.

विग्लै वि-ग्लै, Caus. -ग्लापयति, -यितुम्, to
make distressed, afflict, grieve.
